quotes.name: Clarissa Dane
quotes.quote: I feel like there's a lot of uncertainty in the air, and as a District Attorney, it's my job to stay on top of things and try to make sense of it all, but sometimes it feels like the more I learn, the more questions I have.

quotes.name: Rick Walker
quotes.quote: I feel like there's a lot of uncertainty in the air, and it's hard to know what's going to happen next. As a line cook, I'm used to being in the thick of things, but this feels different. I'm just trying to stay focused on my work and my family, and hope that everything works out.

quotes.name: Rafael Pilgrim
quotes.quote: I feel like there's a lot of uncertainty in the air, and it's hard to know what's going to happen next. I've been talking to people around Fruitvale, and everyone seems to be waiting to see what happens. It's like we're all holding our breath, trying to make sense of things.

quotes.name: Tomas Renteria
quotes.quote: I feel like there's a lot of uncertainty in the air, you know, it's like people are waiting to see what's gonna happen next. I've been talking to folks around Fruitvale, and everyone's got their own take on it, but nobody really knows what's going on. It's like we're all just trying to figure it out as we go.

claim: I feel like there's a lot of uncertainty in the air, and as a District Attorney, it's my job to stay on top of things and try to make sense of it all, but sometimes it feels like the more I learn, the more questions I have.
